desktopDOM.description:
The Florida satellite map presents the peninsula, Panhandle and Florida Keys in a single landscape composition. Coastal waters frame the state, while inland lakes, vegetation and built-up areas add detail within the highlighted outline.

Use the image in editorial maps, presentations about Florida and regional display graphics. The long coastline and distinctive shape of the peninsula make it a visual base for coastal and travel-themed layouts, as well as printed map compositions.

FAQ
Can I use this map in GIS programs?

This map is not geo-referenced, but feel free to contact us to obtain a file with geo data if needed.
